title: Splinter Weapon/Skill history
wikitext:
{{skill history}}
== March 22, 2012 ==
* '''Guild Wars Wiki Notes''': Splinter Weapon: non-concise description changed from dealing damage to 3 adjacent foes to 4 adjacent foes, describing the actual effect; however, the concise description was not changed and still lists the incorrect figure.

{{clear}}
